notes.title: TAKE the opportunity to Protect Your Fool with 50% DISCOUNT!

notes.title: Baby Fool is waiting for you!
notes.content:
Guardian Protectors,

Some of you requested a softer and adaptable experience at the beginning of the journey.

We heard you and created an Easy difficulty, specially made for the less experienced.

The new difficulty is intended for a more balanced climb, so the adventure still begins in Normal mode. Therefore, Steam Achievements are disabled on this difficulty.

Easy difficulty features:

- Choose which theme you want to play on.
- Improved learning curve.
- Protect our new dear Baby Fool.
- Fewer enemy objects on screen.
- Level 10 is an introduction to more challenging enemy objects.
- New victory trophy will make you jaw drop.

The Baby Fool is in trouble, trapped in a little nightmare. Don't make him wake up crying from the nightmare. Protect the Baby Fool!
